name: Valves
summary: Valves that control water, air and gas: electric solenoid valves, ball, check and float valves.
uses: Shut-offs and taps for water systems
identify: Solenoid valves with a coil on top in washing machines, dishwashers, fridges with ice makers, irrigation boxes and coffee machines; ball valves and taps on plumbing; float valves in toilet cisterns and stock troughs.
test: Feed the coil its rated voltage: it should click. Most solenoid valves need some water pressure to open fully.

decay.note: Lasts; rubber seats harden after many years.
